description: Picks the model a conversation runs on: the trigger names the chosen model plus its state tags, and the popup lists the host's catalogue as a role="listbox" whose every row compares the models on speed, quality, price per million input tokens and context window — as a bar AND as the number in words, because a bar alone is colour-only information. The list is grouped by GroupBy (provider, family or nothing) and searched live; the hits are marked by TmHighlightedText and a group with no surviving model disappears instead of leaving an empty heading. A model that does not report a value renders no bar and no chip — "not reported" is never painted as a zero. The selected model's reasoning options (extended thinking, effort levels) sit ABOVE the list, never inside an option: an option is a leaf of the listbox and may not contain a switch or a radio. The whole answer is Selection (@bind-Selection): the model id, the extended-thinking switch and the reasoning-effort level. Keyboard: the trigger is a native button; focus moves into the search field, which is the popup's combobox carrying aria-activedescendant, and with ShowSearch off the listbox itself owns the arrows, Enter (keydown), Space (keyup) and type-ahead. The trigger is named by its own visible text (a visually hidden "Model:" prefix plus the model, its provider and every state tag), the listbox by the localized "Models" label, and one polite live region announces the pick, the reasoning changes and the search match count. On a phone the popup is a bottom sheet.

examples.title: A catalogue with a bound selection
examples.code:
<TmModelPicker Models="@models"
               @bind-Selection="selection"
               EstimatedPromptTokens="100000"
               PriceFormatter="FormatPrice" />

@code {
    private AiModelSelection? selection = new("gpt-4o");
    private IReadOnlyList<AiModelInfo> models = [
        new("gpt-4o", "GPT-4o") { Provider = "OpenAI", ContextWindow = 128_000, SpeedScore = 4, QualityScore = 5, InputPricePerMillion = 3m },
        new("gpt-4o-mini", "GPT-4o mini") { Provider = "OpenAI", ContextWindow = 128_000, SpeedScore = 5, QualityScore = 3, InputPricePerMillion = 0.15m },
    ];
}

examples.title: Grouped by family, with the reasoning options
A compact toolbar picker without the search field
Comparing without closing the list
examples.code:
<TmModelPicker Models="@models" CloseOnSelect="false" SelectionChanged="OnSelection" />

@code {
    private void OnSelection(AiModelSelection? value)
    {
        // Every change lands here, including the reasoning options of the selected model.
    }
}

parameters.name: Models
parameters.description: The catalogue to choose from. The component never mutates it; the host's order is the reading order and a group keeps the order its models arrive in. Null or empty renders an empty state rather than an empty listbox.

parameters.name: Selection
parameters.description: The current answer, two-way bound with SelectionChanged (@bind-Selection). Null renders the placeholder trigger. A host may keep the picker uncontrolled: a pick still renders and the host's stale parameter never overwrites it.

parameters.name: SelectionChanged
parameters.description: Fires with the whole new selection: a picked model (the reasoning options at the model's defaults), a toggled extended thinking or a chosen effort level.

parameters.name: GroupBy
parameters.description: How the list is grouped. Default AiModelGroupBy.Provider; a model that does not report the property lands in the localized "Other" group and is never dropped.

parameters.name: ShowSearch
parameters.description: Whether the search field is rendered. Default true. Without it the listbox is the popup's tab stop and offers type-ahead instead.

parameters.name: SearchPlaceholder
parameters.description: The placeholder of the search field. Null uses the localized default.

parameters.name: ShowCapabilities
parameters.description: Whether a row renders the model's capability chips. Default true.

parameters.name: ShowSpeed
parameters.description: Whether a row renders its speed bar and value. Default true; a model that reports no score renders neither.

parameters.name: ShowQuality
parameters.description: Whether a row renders its quality bar and value. Default true; a model that reports no score renders neither.

parameters.name: ShowPrice
parameters.description: Whether a row renders its input price bar and value. Default true; an unreported price renders neither (an unknown price is never painted as free).

parameters.name: ShowContextWindow
parameters.description: Whether a row renders its context window chip. Default true; an unreported window renders no chip.

parameters.name: ShowExtendedThinking
parameters.description: Whether the selected model's extended-thinking switch is offered when the model supports it. Default true.

parameters.name: ShowEffort
parameters.description: Whether the selected model's reasoning-effort control is offered when the model reports levels. Default true.

parameters.name: EstimatedPromptTokens
parameters.description: How many prompt tokens the next request is expected to send. When set (and the selected model reports an input price) the panel renders the estimated prompt cost, formatted with the culture's currency. Null renders no estimate.

parameters.name: CloseOnSelect
parameters.description: Whether a pick closes the popup. Default true (the combobox behaviour). false keeps the list open so the reader can compare models; the picked row is then marked as selected in place.

parameters.name: Disabled
parameters.description: Disables the trigger and every control of the popup: nothing opens and nothing is raised.

parameters.name: Culture
parameters.description: The culture that formats the prices, the estimate and the speed/quality numbers. Null means the current culture at render time.

parameters.name: PriceFormatter
parameters.description: Formats a money amount — a price per million tokens and the prompt estimate. Null uses AiCostFormatter with Culture (the culture's own currency and symbol position). A host with credits or a fixed exchange rate overrides it.

parameters.name: Title
parameters.description: The visible heading of the popup (and of the bottom sheet, when the popup presents as one). Null uses the localized "Choose a model". The listbox is named separately by the localized "Models" label, so the title is not spoken twice.

parameters.name: ShowTitle
parameters.description: Whether the heading is rendered inside the popup. Default true; the listbox keeps its name either way.

parameters.name: AriaLabel
parameters.description: An optional accessible name for the trigger. Null (the default) lets the trigger's own visible text name it — the localized "Model:" prefix plus the model, its provider and every state tag — and the root group is named by the localized "Model". Setting it replaces that name; the state tags are then exposed through the trigger's description, so a deprecated or reasoning model is still announced.

parameters.name: LayoutMode
parameters.description: The layout the popup presentation resolves from. Auto follows the viewport; a forced value never measures, so a test can render a mode without a DOM.

parameters.name: MobilePresentation
parameters.description: How the popup presents on a narrow viewport. Default Auto — the anchored popover on a wide layout and a bottom sheet on a phone.

parameters.name: Class
parameters.description: Additional CSS class(es) for the root element.
